73172-the-pardoner-s-wallet.title: The Pardoner S Wallet
73172-the-pardoner-s-wallet.creator: Samuel M. Crothers
73172-the-pardoner-s-wallet.description: A book by Samuel M. Crothers. He took advantage of their weaknesses. Many a good wife would purchase a pardon she had no need of, simply because he offered it as a bargain. We all know how the business of indulgence-selling was overdone. There was a general loss of confidence on the part of the purchasing public; and at last in the days of the too enterprising Tetzel there came a disastrous slump.

arxiv-2003-09839.title: A New Update Rule of ADFF-RLS & EKF based Joint-estimation Filters for Real-time SOC/SOH Identification
arxiv-2003-09839.creator: Kwangrae Kim, Minho Kim, Suwon Kang, Jungwook Yu, Jungsoo Kim, Huiyong Chun, Soohee Han
arxiv-2003-09839.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Kwangrae Kim, Minho Kim, Suwon Kang, Jungwook Yu, Jungsoo Kim, Huiyong Chun, Soohee Han. In order to accurately estimate the SOC and SOH of a lithium-ion battery used in an electric vehicle (EV), we propose an Adaptive Diagonal Forgetting Factor Recursive Least Square (ADFF-RLS) for accurate battery parameter estimation. ADFF-RLS includes two new proposals in the existing DFF-RLS; The first is an excitation tag that changes the behavior of the DFF-RLS and the EKF according to the dynamics of the input data.

arxiv-2108-11223.title: A Survey on Radio Frequency Identification as a Scalable Technology to Face Pandemics
arxiv-2108-11223.creator: Giulio M. Bianco, Cecilia Occhiuzzi, Nicoletta Panunzio, Gaetano Marrocco
arxiv-2108-11223.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Giulio M. Bianco, Cecilia Occhiuzzi, Nicoletta Panunzio, Gaetano Marrocco. The COVID-19 pandemic drastically changed our way of living. To minimize life losses, multi-level strategies requiring collective efforts were adopted while waiting for the vaccines’ rollout. The management of such complex processes has taken benefit from the rising framework of the Internet of Things (IoT), and particularly the Radiofrequency Identification (RFID) since it is probably the most suitable approach to both the micro (user) and the macro (processes) scale.

arxiv-2111-08753.title: Scintillation Timescales of Bright FRBs Detected by CHIME/FRB Journal: RNAAS
arxiv-2111-08753.creator: Eve Schoen, Calvin Leung, Kiyoshi Masui, Daniele Michilli, Pragya Chawla, Aaron B. Pearlman, Kaitlyn Shin, Ashley Stock
arxiv-2111-08753.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Eve Schoen, Calvin Leung, Kiyoshi Masui, Daniele Michilli, Pragya Chawla, Aaron B. Pearlman, Kaitlyn Shin, Ashley Stock. We describe a pipeline to measure scintillation in fast radio bursts (FRBs) detected by CHIME/FRB in the 400-800 MHz band by analyzing the frequency structure of the FRB’s spectrum. We use the pipeline to measure the characteristic frequency bandwidths of scintillation between 4 − 100 kHz 4-$100\text{\,}\mathrm{kHz}$ in 12 FRBs corresponding to timescales of ∼ \sim 2-40 μ \mu s for 10 FRBs detected by CHIME/FRB.

arxiv-2206-05740.title: Generators for the elliptic curve E ( p , q ) : y 2 = x 3 − p 2 ​ x + q 2 E_{(p,q)}:y^{2}=x^{3}-p^{2}x+q^{2}
arxiv-2206-05740.creator: M. Khazali ,H. Daghigh and A. Alidadi
arxiv-2206-05740.description: Abstract . Let { E ( p , q ) } \{E_{(p,q)}\} represents a family of elliptic curves over ℚ \mathbb{Q} as defined by the Weierstrass equation E ( p , q ) : y 2 = x 3 − p 2 ​ x + q 2 E_{(p,q)}:y^{2}=x^{3}-p^{2}x+q^{2} , where p and q are prime numbers exceeding five.

arxiv-2310-11183.title: Real Topological Hochschild Homology of Perfectoid Rings
arxiv-2310-11183.creator: Jens Hornbostel, Doosung Park
arxiv-2310-11183.description: Abstract . We refine several results of Bhatt-Morrow-Scholze on THH \mathrm{THH} to THR \mathrm{THR} . In particular, we compute THR \mathrm{THR} of perfectoid rings. This will be useful for establishing motivic filtrations on real topological Hochschild and cyclic homology of quasisyntomic rings. We also establish a real refinement of the Hochschild-Kostant-Rosenberg theorem.

arxiv-2311-08207.title: Data-driven Control Against False Data Injection Attacks
arxiv-2311-08207.creator: Wenjie Liu, Lidong Li, Jian Sun, Fang Deng, Gang Wang, Jie Chen
arxiv-2311-08207.description: Abstract The rise of cyber-security concerns has brought significant attention to the analysis and design of cyber-physical systems (CPSs). Among the various types of cyberattacks, denial-of-service (DoS) attacks and false data injection (FDI) attacks can be easily launched and have become prominent threats.

arxiv-2405-00009.title: Service Level Agreements and Security SLA: A Comprehensive Survey
arxiv-2405-00009.creator: Serena Nicolazzo, Antonino Nocera, Witold Pedrycz
arxiv-2405-00009.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Serena Nicolazzo, Antonino Nocera, Witold Pedrycz. A Service Level Agreement (SLA) is a formal contract between a service provider and a consumer, representing a crucial instrument to define, manage, and maintain relationships between these two parties. The SLA’s ability to define the Quality of Service (QoS) expectations, standards, and accountability helps to deliver high-quality services and increase client confidence in disparate application domains, such as Cloud computing and the Internet of Things.

arxiv-2406-13644.title: Kinetic Monte Carlo methods for three-dimensional diffusive capture problems in exterior domains
arxiv-2406-13644.creator: Andrew J. Bernoff, Alan E. Lindsay
arxiv-2406-13644.description: Abstract Cellular scale decision making is modulated by the dynamics of signalling molecules and their diffusive trajectories from a source to small absorbing sites on the cellular surface. Diffusive capture problems which model this process are computationally challenging due to their complex geometry and mixed boundary conditions together with intrinsically long transients that occur before a particle is captured.

arxiv-2502-00847.title: SecPE : Secure Prompt Ensembling for Private and Robust Large Language Models
arxiv-2502-00847.creator: Jiawen Zhang, Kejia Chen, Zunlei Feng, Jian Lou, Mingli Song, Jian Liu, Xiaohu Yang
arxiv-2502-00847.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jiawen Zhang, Kejia Chen, Zunlei Feng, Jian Lou, Mingli Song, Jian Liu, Xiaohu Yang. With the growing popularity of LLMs among the general public users, privacy-preserving and adversarial robustness have become two pressing demands for LLM-based services, which have largely been pursued separately but rarely jointly. In this paper, to the best of our knowledge, we are among the first attempts towards robust and private LLM inference by tightly integrating two disconnected fields: private inference and prompt ensembling.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-states-of-the.creator: Gustav Schnürer
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-states-of-the.description: Article 'States of the Church' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

plos-pone-0356727.creator: Saeed Pirmoradi, Sevil Vaghefi Moghaddam, Mohammadreza Ardalan, Mir Mohsen Sharifi Bonab, Mohammad Teshnehlab, Sepideh Zununi Vahed
plos-pone-0356727.description: Graph neural network-based risk stratification of prostate cancer using gene expression and SHAP interpretability

pmc-10673350.title: Prevention of Migration of Esophageal Self-Expandable Metallic Stents Using Endoscopic Clips
pmc-10673350.creator: Nikola Boyanov, Katina Shtereva, Katerina Madzharova, Liuben Kirkov, Neno Shopov, Vladimir Andonov
pmc-10673350.description: Background and Objectives: Esophageal stenting with self-expandable metallic stents (SEMS), for both benign and malignant reasons, has been widely practiced for decades, but migration still remains the most common complication of the procedure. In this report we aim to review our experience and results in stent fixation with clips.

pmc-11271029.title: The incretin effect in type 2 diabetes in a Sub-Saharan African population
pmc-11271029.creator: Signe Tellerup Nielsen, Belinda Kweka, George Praygod, Suzanne Filteau, Mette Frahm Olsen, Henrik Friis, Daniel Faurholt-Jepsen, Rikke Krogh-Madsen
pmc-11271029.description: AimType 2 diabetes is increasing in Sub-Saharan Africa, but the pathophysiology in this population is poorly investigated. In Western populations, the incretin effect is reduced in type 2 diabetes, leading to lowered insulin secretion. The aim of this study was to investigate the incretin effect in a group of Sub-Saharan Africans with type 2 diabetes.

pmc-11301821.title: Comparing cadaveric and 3D‐printed laryngeal models in transcutaneous injection laryngoplasty
pmc-11301821.creator: Megha Chandna, Sana Siddiqui, Dylan Bertoni, Marah Sakkal, Sara Belko, Maurits Boon, Joseph Spiegel
pmc-11301821.description: BackgroundThere is increasing focus on the development of high‐quality simulation models for medical education. Cadaveric models, although considered more realistic, may be difficult to obtain and costly. The advent of three‐dimensional (3D) printing has offered a low‐cost, reliable, and reproducible alternative. This study sought to compare the utility of 3D‐printed to cadaveric models for training in transcutaneous injection laryngoplasty (TIL).

pmc-11313707.title: QCL Infrared Spectroscopy Combined with Machine Learning as a Useful Tool for Classifying Acetaminophen Tablets by Brand
pmc-11313707.creator: José A. Martínez-Trespalacios, Daniel E. Polo-Herrera, Tamara Y. Félix-Massa, Samuel P. Hernandez-Rivera, Joaquín Hernandez-Fernandez, Fredy Colpas-Castillo, John R. Castro-Suarez
pmc-11313707.description: The development of new methods of identification of active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) is a subject of paramount importance for research centers, the pharmaceutical industry, and law enforcement agencies. Here, a system for identifying and classifying pharmaceutical tablets containing acetaminophen (AAP) by brand has been developed. In total, 15 tablets of 11 brands for a total of 165 samples were analyzed.

pmc-11439360.title: Integrating a Personal Finance Workshop to Enhance Financial Literacy Among Senior Medical Students: A Single Institution’s Experience
pmc-11439360.creator: Parker A Woolley, Mark C Kendall, Simon Tacvorian, Shyamal Asher
pmc-11439360.description: PurposeGraduating medical students frequently start their training burdened with substantial financial debt and minimal savings, especially in comparison to their peers in other professional fields. A lack of financial literacy can result in increased debt, decreased job satisfaction and contribute to physician burnout. Enhancing financial education could improve both the financial stability and emotional well-being of future medical professionals.

pmc-11612448.title: Reliability analysis of subsea control system using FMEA and FFTA
pmc-11612448.creator: Chao Liu, Guangxin Li, Wensheng Xiao, Jian Liu, Liping Tan, Changjiang Li, Teng Wang, Fengran Yang, Chengzhi Xue
pmc-11612448.description: Reliability technology plays a significant role in ensuring the safe operation of the subsea control system. To perform a comprehensive analysis of the reliability of complex systems, a combination of Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and Fuzzy Fault Tree Approach (FFTA) is introduced.

pmc-11689862.title: INTERVENTIONS FOR COGNITIVE FRAILTY: DELPHI CONSENSUS WITH RESEARCHERS, CLINICIANS, AND EXPERTS BY EXPERIENCE
pmc-11689862.creator: Carol Holland, Nikolette Dravecz, Susan Broughton, Sally Fowler Davis, Mandy Dixon
pmc-11689862.description: The conjunction of physical frailty and cognitive impairment without dementia is described as Cognitive Frailty (CF). Indications that CF is potentially reversible has led to proposals that addressing risk factors, symptoms or mechanisms of CF would be appropriate targets for interventions for prevention, delay or reversal.

pmc-12333070.title: ICDA-S-II index improves early-stage diagnosis of carious lesions among schoolchildren in northern Brazil
pmc-12333070.creator: Davi Lavareda Corrêa, Flávia M Flório, Vânia Castro Corrêa, Suelen Lavareda Corrêa, Sue A Lavareda Corrêa Uchôa, Cecilia Pedroso Turssi
pmc-12333070.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The Decayed, Missing and Filled Teeth (DMFT) index is widely used for detecting carious lesions, primarily focusing on established cavities, while the International Caries Detection and Assessment System (ICDA-S-II) is designed to identify incipient lesions. Aim:The aim of this cross-sectional study was to assess the diagnostic effectiveness of the DMFT index compared to the ICDA-S-II criteria designed for early-stage carious lesion diagnosis in schoolchildren from Belém (Brazil).

pmc-12452971.title: Extended-Spectrum β-Lactamase-Producing Klebsiella pneumoniae in Southwest China: Molecular Characteristics and Risk Factors of Bloodstream Infections
pmc-12452971.creator: Yueshuai Wei, Yuan Jiang, Chenghong Gu, Caihong Ye, Tongtong Guo, Zhangrui Zeng, Jinbo Liu
pmc-12452971.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PurposeThe objective of this study was to investigate the molecular characteristics and risk factors of bloodstream infection (BSI) caused by extended-spectrum beta-lactamase producing Klebsiella pneumoniae (ESBL-Kpn).MethodsBacterial species were identified using the matrix-assisted laser desorption ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry (MALDI-TOF MS) (Bruker Daltonik GmbH, Bremen, Germany), while antimicrobial susceptibilities were assessed using the MicroScan WalkAway 96 Plus system (Siemens, Germany) and the microbroth dilution method. Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) was employed to detect common extended-spectrum beta-lactamase resistance genes (blaSHV, blaTEM, blaCTX-M).

pmc-12504593.title: Assessing the effect of social contact structure on the impact of pneumococcal conjugate vaccines
pmc-12504593.creator: Anabelle Wong, Sarah C Kramer, Daniel M Weinberger, Matthieu Domenech de Cellès
pmc-12504593.description: Although pneumococcal conjugate vaccines (PCVs) have greatly reduced diseases caused by vaccine-targeted serotypes (VT) of Streptococcus pneumoniae, vaccine impact may be eroded by the increase in rates of disease caused by non-vaccine serotypes (NVT). Here, we investigated the effect of social contact patterns on the dynamics of vaccine impact in carriage.

pmc-12625997.title: Extracellular nanobody screening using conformationally stable GPCR variants
pmc-12625997.creator: Xin Zhang, Kaixuan Gao, Jia Nie, Hengyu Meng, Xiaoou Sun, Jiawei Zhao, Xiangyu Liu
pmc-12625997.description: SignificanceWe present a universal strategy to stabilize G protein–coupled receptors (GPCRs) in defined conformational states, overcoming challenges posed by their intrinsic dynamics. Through de novo design of fusion proteins to lock the M1 muscarinic receptor in its active conformation and screening synthetic nanobody libraries against distinct states, we identified conformation-specific binders.

pmc-12774992.title: Effectiveness of a multidomain lifestyle counseling intervention on intrinsic capacity in older women: a randomized clinical trial
pmc-12774992.creator: Mahsa Rouhani-Otaghsara, Shabnam Omidvar, Mahdi Sepidarkish, Afsaneh Bakhtiari, Fatemeh Nasiri-Amiri
pmc-12774992.description: BackgroundIntrinsic capacity (IC), the composite of physical and mental capacities, is crucial for health and well-being in older adults. With aging populations experiencing IC decline, effective interventions are needed to promote healthy aging. This study evaluated the effectiveness of a structured lifestyle counseling program on IC in older women.

pmc-13053946.title: The primary care brain health navigator: A perspective on implementation
pmc-13053946.creator: Deanna R. Willis, Diana Summanwar, Nicole R. Fowler, Jared R. Brosch, Dustin B. Hammers
pmc-13053946.description: Gaps in primary care (PC) early detection are caused by systems‐based issues that require a systems‐based solution. A PC brain health navigator (BHN) can mitigate the time limitations of PC providers, standardize high‐quality PC‐based evaluation of cognitive impairment, and improve the appropriateness of specialty care referrals.

pmc-13126138.title: Sleep quality and its relationship with physical activity and frailty syndrome among hospitalized older adults in North Iran
pmc-13126138.creator: Leila Zahed Nakhjiri, Azar Darvishpour, Ali Nouri, Ameneh Beig Mohammadi
pmc-13126138.description: BackgroundSleep disorders are a prevalent concern among older adults, contributing to reduced physical function. A bidirectional relationship between sleep disorders and frailty syndrome has been suggested.ObjectivesThis study aimed to investigate sleep quality and its associations with physical activity and frailty syndrome among hospitalized older adults.

pmc-13304565.title: Structural Knowledge Is What Matters in Protein–Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction

pmc-13470163.title: Scalable bioreactor manufacturing of iPSC-derived megakaryocytes with Proanthocyanidin A supplementation: a strategic platform for military blood supply resilience
pmc-13470163.creator: Rabea Dettmer, Alice Rovai, Willem Wolkers, Rainer Blasczyk, Constanca Figueiredo
pmc-13470163.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). nerable due to their short shelf life and dependence on continuous donor supply chains [2]. Strengthening transfusion resilience for military operations therefore requires scalable, donor-independent manufacturing strategies compatible with decentralized or strategically buffered production. Here, we describe the implementation of a stirred-suspension bioreactor platform for large-scale generation of induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived megakaryocytes (MKs), integrating cost-reduction measures to enhance strategic feasibility for defense medical logistics.

pmc-13477377.title: Total Clinical Event Burden With Edoxaban Monotherapy Versus Dual Antithrombotic Therapy in Atrial Fibrillation and Stable Coronary Artery Disease: Insights From the EPIC‐CAD Trial
pmc-13477377.creator: Sung‐Hwan Kim, Min Soo Cho, Soyoon Park, Young Choi, Jung‐Bok Lee, Duk‐Woo Park, Gi‐Byoung Nam, Yong‐Seog Oh
pmc-13477377.description: BackgroundOral anticoagulation is essential for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation, whereas antiplatelet therapy remains standard for coronary artery disease (CAD), raising concerns about bleeding when both are combined. The effect of these regimens on recurrent events, reflecting cumulative disease burden, has not been fully evaluated.

pmc-13546837.title: Cardiovascular health among young adults: Do childhood neighborhoods matter?
pmc-13546837.creator: Noreen Goldman, Boriana Pratt, Heeju Sohn, Stephanie Enkel, Norrina Bai Allen, Hongyan Ning, Donald Lloyd-Jones, Daniel Notterman

pmc-13661721.title: Diagnostic performance of a single breath-hold lung MRI scan with AI-powered compressed sensing for nodule detection in comparison to photon counting detector-CT
pmc-13661721.creator: Anna Palmisano, Giulia Piccinni, Davide Serra, Elisa Bruno, Giulio Ferrazzi, Davide Vignale, Carlo Tacchetti, Antonio Esposito
pmc-13661721.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectiveThe aim was to evaluate the performance of a single-breath-hold accelerated 3D-T1w-FFE 3-T MRI sequence for screening lung nodules, compared with photon-counting detector CT (PCD-CT), which served as the reference standard.Materials and methodsIn this single-center prospective study, 148 healthy adults underwent lung 3-T MRI between June 2024 and June 2025 using a single-breath-hold, AI-aided compressed sensing (AI-CS)- accelerated 3D-T1-FFE sequence (acceleration factor of 9) to evaluate for the presence of lung nodules.
